name: verify_pipeline
description: Run lint/test/typecheck from package.json. WARNING: MCP requests have a 120s hard timeout; default is 30s per stage (3 stages = 90s). Large test suites will time out — prefer stages=lint or test_bridge(action=run) for full test runs.

workspace_dir.description: REQUIRED: project root (abs). reindex first if new.

workdir.description: Optional subdir to run in (default workspace_dir)
